caption: The drawing features a central object resembling a hanging organizer with five pockets, each outlined and divided by a bold red border. The pockets are cream-colored with various cross-stitched patterns. The top pocket has a symmetrical, floral cross-stitch design with yellow and blue thread and two small green designs on either side. The second pocket displays two potted plant motifs, one on each side, and an abstract, centrally-placed motif with elements of yellow, blue, and purple. The third pocket contains two identical floral arrangements in vases, mainly in yellow, green, and blue. The fourth pocket shows a single large floral motif in a vase with a blue base and yellow, green, and brown details, with two small green elements by the sides. The fifth pocket has the text "Sarah Barlows Work 1841" stitched in brown thread and a small floral motif underneath. Surrounding the organizer, arranged vertically on both left and right sides, are various cross-stitched motifs including potted flowers, geometric and abstract patterns, animal shapes, and a butterfly, using blue, green, yellow, brown, and purple thread. Each motif outside the central organizer is labeled with a small number. The background is an off-white or beige color, and the overall composition is symmetrical around the vertical axis of the hanging organizer.
title: Needlework Picture
